description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android activity class 'NoteShareDetailActivity' which manages sharing notes within an application. It handles UI initialization, user interactions for setting share permissions, expiration dates, passwords, and the creation or modification of share entities. The class interacts with a repository to perform network or database operations related to shared notes, and includes logic for different share types, UI updates, and validation.

classes.name: NoteShareDetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity handling note sharing, including UI for permissions, expiration, passwords, and note content. It manages creating/updating shares, user interactions, and UI updates based on share type and activity step.
